semantic.justification: Actual InputSource Reference/OUString aggregate ownership, cached XLocator SDK, generated SAXException and FastLocatorImpl component now admit genuine XInputStream bytes through XMLFile2UTFConverter. Source copies and ParserData snapshots precede document callbacks; 16KiB reads stop at EOF without closing input. The existing saxes backend receives incrementally decoded UTF8/UTF16/UTF32 or actual RTL legacy-descriptor output without DOM. This backend binding is not a port or certification of native libxml2 encoding aliases, diagnostics or locator positions. Host FastSaxParseError remains an explicit host envelope; only the missing-input SAXException is an actual generated UNO exception. Native parser mutex/thread machinery, complete XFastParser service, unported RTL encodings, allocation unwind/ABI and full package/model/filter/DOCX/XLSX/Worker/UI acceptance remain unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery behavior is preserved. SAX inherited member address lowering is now exercised by actual typed SAXParseException Any copy and base extraction. Actual generated exception values expose real stable inherited Message/Context fields to existing UNO compound copy/extraction, removing temporary Context cells and the old test shadow Map. IllegalArgumentException short and DOMException enum storage retain original widths/defaults/moves with actual stable addresses; wrapped exceptions expose their existing Any member. Other affected derived implementations only declare required base overrides. Critical tests use real exceptions, Any, ActiveDataSink and weak references, with native source-captured Any replays and original import-order checks. This is a local logical-layout correction, not a new exception factory, type provider or physical C++ ABI/allocator/thread claim. Full exception bridge/getCaughtException/source misc QA, Content/resolver/DocumentBuilder/metadata and DOCX/XLSX/UI remain unqualified.
